verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's site claims an ecosystem of 3,900+ providers and 23,600+ modules for managing infrastructure "across every cloud platform." It shows SaaS-style use cases such as DNS and GitHub repository/team management, and its drop-in Terraform compatibility is corroborated by community reports that it reuses upstream providers and migrates easily. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the provider registry naming the specific major clouds and SaaS providers supported, and independent hands-on verification of provider breadth beyond marketing figures.
